# webaudio-controls (vendored for the demos)

`webaudio-controls.js` is an unmodified copy of the file of that name in
[g200kg/webaudio-controls](https://github.com/g200kg/webaudio-controls) at commit
`282610abc14e0ab3c6273a0b977ae5d6677f426c` (2025-10-04).

- Size 72,761 bytes, sha256 `2f780008a1895c3d1b583d99f4f50c35fc2870bf47e117574361465dc5784f65`.
- License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, identical to the upstream file at that commit). The copyright header in the script is kept.
- Used by `simple.html` (`<webaudio-keyboard>`) and `soundedit.html` (`<webaudio-knob>`, `<webaudio-switch>`, `<webaudio-keyboard>`). It is not part of the npm package or the synthesizer.

Do not edit the file. To update it, replace it with another upstream commit's file and record the new commit and sha256 here.
The Polymer 1 version that used to live in this directory (`webaudio-controls.html`, its samples and images, and the bower metadata) was unused and has been removed.
